methods.name: DCT-Unet++ model
methods.summary: An improved Unet++ architecture for landslide area extraction that incorporates Dilated Convolution for multi-scale feature extraction, integrates Channel and Spatial Attention Mechanisms (CBAM) and Transformer modules, and utilizes multi-task learning (segmentation and edge detection) with Conditional Random Fields (CRFs) for post-processing.
methods.source: Junxin Wang, Qintong Zhang, Hao Xie, Yingying Chen, and Rui Sun
methods.verbatim: We have innovatively proposed a model named DCT-Unet++... The code related to the experiment is stored at https://github.com/xinxin2021110/DCT-UNETplusplus, accessed on 12 August 2024.

code_links.name: DCT-UNet++ code for landslide segmentation
code_links.summary: Custom code implementing the DCT-UNet++ model, hosted alongside the study's data in the same GitHub repository.

availability.author_statement: Full data and code availability statement, with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The Datasets are referenced and publicly available. The custom DCT-Unet++ model code is provided via a persistent GitHub repository link, which provides data.
